title: Minecraft Survival Games
description: Join the Minecraft Survival Games tournament at BetaLAN! Compete in thrilling PvP battles, survive the shrinking arena, and win exciting prizes.
heading: Minecraft Survival Games

whatIs.title: What is the Minecraft Survival Games?
whatIs.intro: It's basically {{hungerGames}}, but in Minecraft! Do you love playing Minecraft?
whatIs.outro: Maybe you're great at fighting games or even better at dodging attacks? Then this is the perfect game for you!

participate.title: How do I participate?
participate.text: The minecraft server has a whitelist policy, so to join the tournament, you need to register your Minecraft username in advance. You can do so at this {{form}}. Please signup before 15:00 Sunday 21st of September so we have time to add everyone to the server. Then you will be able to join with the minecraft server address below.
participate.formAriaLabel: Google Forms link to register for the Minecraft Survival Games tournament

rules.title: Rules
rules.who: **Who can play?** – You play alone, no teams!
rules.warning: Cheating or not following the rules will result in disqualification and immediate removal from the competition.

how.title: How it works?
how.text: Players are dropped into a world with chests scattered across the map, some in the center and others around the map. The goal is to fight other players in PvP battles, with the last remaining player (or team) being the winner. As the game progresses, the area shrinks, pushing players closer together.

when.title: When?
when.text: 📢 The competition starts on Sunday 21st at 16:00
